name: Joint leave (cuti bersama)
authority: SKB 3 Menteri No. 1497 Tahun 2025, No. 2 Tahun 2025 and No. 5 Tahun 2025 — 8 cuti bersama days for 2026. For the private sector the SKB is guidance the employer implements, and a cuti bersama day taken is set against the annual leave entitlement. a cuti bersama day taken is set against the annual leave (SKB 3 Menteri; `consumes_code`).

name: Annual leave
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 79(3) as amended by Law 6/2023 Window: each year of service (`SERVICE_YEAR`): UU 13/2003 art.79(3) grants 12 days after each 12 months of continuous work. Owner ruling (ID): the balance resets each leave year and at most 5 unused days carry into the next (`carry_forward`), once. On exit the unused, unlapsed balance is paid (PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(a)).

entitlement.days: size(bands.filter(b, service_months >= b.service_months).map(b, b.days)) > 0 ? first(bands.filter(b, service_months >= b.service_months).map(b, b.days)) : 0.0

name: Medical leave
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(a) and 93(3) UU 13/2003 art.93(3): 100% of the wage for the first four months of continuous illness, 75% for the next four, 50% for the next four and 25% thereafter (`pay_fraction` over `leave.month_index`).

name: Maternity leave
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 82(1); Law 4/2024 (KIA) Art. 4(2)(a) and 4(3) — a further 3 months on a doctor's certificate, paid 100% to month 4 and 75% for months 5-6 three months per birth, and up to three further on a doctor’s certificate for post-partum complications or a sick newborn (UU 4/2024 art.4(3); `event.kind == "BIRTH_COMPLICATION"`), paid in full through month four and at 75% for months five and six (`pay_fraction`).

name: Paternity leave
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(c) and 93(4)(e); Law 4/2024 (KIA) Art. 6(2)(a) allows up to 3 further days two days per birth (art.93(4)(e)), and up to three further where the birth had complications (UU 4/2024 art.6(2)(a); `event.kind`). UU 4/2024 (KIA) art.6(1): two days for the wife’s delivery, three more by agreement (BIRTH_COMPLICATION carries five); two days for the wife’s miscarriage. Paid days per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); art.81(1) for menstrual leave): the entitlement meters one event (`facts.event_id`) — an entry without one is its own event.

name: Marriage leave
eligibility: has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["MARRIAGE"] && has(entry.facts.relationship) && entry.facts.relationship in ["SELF"]
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(c) and 93(4)(a) — the worker marries a grant per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); `event.kind`, `event.relationship`). Paid days per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); art.81(1) for menstrual leave): the entitlement meters one event (`facts.event_id`) — an entry without one is its own event.

name: Child's marriage leave
eligibility: has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["MARRIAGE"] && has(entry.facts.relationship) && entry.facts.relationship in ["CHILD"]
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(c) and 93(4)(b) — the worker's child marries a grant per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); `event.kind`, `event.relationship`). Paid days per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); art.81(1) for menstrual leave): the entitlement meters one event (`facts.event_id`) — an entry without one is its own event.

name: Child's circumcision leave
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(c) and 93(4)(c) — the worker's child is circumcised a grant per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); `event.kind`, `event.relationship`). Paid days per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); art.81(1) for menstrual leave): the entitlement meters one event (`facts.event_id`) — an entry without one is its own event.

name: Child's baptism leave
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(c) and 93(4)(d) — the worker's child is baptised a grant per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); `event.kind`, `event.relationship`). Paid days per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); art.81(1) for menstrual leave): the entitlement meters one event (`facts.event_id`) — an entry without one is its own event.

name: Bereavement leave (immediate family)
eligibility: has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["DEATH"] && has(entry.facts.relationship) && entry.facts.relationship in ["SPOUSE", "CHILD", "PARENT", "PARENT_IN_LAW", "CHILD_IN_LAW"]
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(c) and 93(4)(f) — the worker's spouse, parent, parent-in-law, child or child-in-law dies a grant per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); `event.kind`, `event.relationship`). UU 13/2003 art.93(4)(e): a spouse, child, child-in-law, parent or parent-in-law — two days paid. Paid days per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); art.81(1) for menstrual leave): the entitlement meters one event (`facts.event_id`) — an entry without one is its own event.

name: Bereavement leave (household member)
eligibility: has(entry.facts.event_kind) && entry.facts.event_kind in ["DEATH"] && has(entry.facts.relationship) && entry.facts.relationship in ["HOUSEHOLD"]
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(c) and 93(4)(g) — another member of the worker's household dies a grant per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); `event.kind`, `event.relationship`). Paid days per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); art.81(1) for menstrual leave): the entitlement meters one event (`facts.event_id`) — an entry without one is its own event.

name: Menstrual leave
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 81(1) — a female worker in pain during menstruation who notifies the employer is not obliged to work on the first and second day Paid days per event (UU 13/2003 art.93(4); art.81(1) for menstrual leave): the entitlement meters one event (`facts.event_id`) — an entry without one is its own event.

name: Miscarriage leave
authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 82(2) — 1.5 months' rest on a doctor's or midwife's certificate; Law 4/2024 (KIA) Art. 4(2)(b)

name: Cuti ibadah (religious duty leave)
authority: UU 13/2003 art.93(2)(e): wages are paid while the worker performs a religious duty their religion commands (the haji); PP 36/2021 art.40(3) continuing PP 78/2015 art.28: once during the employment with the same employer. No instrument states a duration — the leave is the duty’s own length (`UNLIMITED`, one event: `lifetime_events`), the pay the full wage.

name: Work accident or occupational disease leave
description: Absence after a work accident or occupational disease, while the worker cannot work (sementara tidak mampu bekerja).
authority: UU 13/2003 art.86 and PP 44/2015: the employer keeps paying the wage of a worker unable to work after a work accident and claims the JKK temporary-incapacity benefit (STMB) from BPJS Ketenagakerjaan; the benefit rates were amended by PP 82/2019 and are not seeded (unverified here), so the absence is paid in full. PP 44/2015 art.43: the accident is reported within 2 × 24 hours (task WORK_ACCIDENT_REPORT). https://www.bpjsketenagakerjaan.go.id/assets/uploads/peraturan/15122015_104557_PP%2044%20Tahun%202015.pdf
